name: Logo
description:
A brand logo: a circular mark (drawn with Phlex's SVG builder) plus a wordmark.

  Logo()                                                    # Behumble.com
  Logo(prefix: "Be", name: "humble", suffix: ".com", size: :lg)
  Logo(variant: :mark, href: root_path)                     # just the circle

The wordmark is real text (page font, selectable, any length) in three parts: a bold prefix, a light name and an accent-coloured suffix. Sized in em, so `size:` (or any text-* class) scales the mark and the text together.
usage: Call the kit method inside a Phlex view that includes UI (e.g. `Logo(**props) { … }`); unknown keywords (class:, id:, data:, aria_*) go to the root element.

examples.name: Usage
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex justify-center py-6") do
    Logo(prefix:, name:, suffix:, size:, accent:, variant:, **given(href:))
  end
end

examples.name: Sizes
examples.notes: `size:` sets the font size; the mark is 1.6em, so it scales with the text.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-start gap-6") do
    UI::Logo::SIZES.each_key { |size| Logo(size:) }
  end
end

examples.name: Variants
examples.notes:
`variant: :mark` for favicons, avatars and tight spots (it gets an accessible name),
`variant: :wordmark` for text-only placements.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col items-start gap-10") do
    Logo(size: :lg)
    Logo(size: :lg, variant: :mark)
    Logo(size: :lg, variant: :wordmark)
  end
end

examples.name: Accents
examples.notes: The disc and the suffix share one accent colour.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "grid gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2") do
    { blue: [ "Be", "humble", ".com" ], green: [ "Grow", "kind", ".org" ], violet: [ "", "Sproutly", ".app" ], orange: [ "My", "garden", ".io" ] }.each do |accent, (prefix, name, suffix)|
      Logo(prefix:, name:, suffix:, accent:, size: :md)
    end
  end
end

examples.name: In components
examples.notes: A linked logo in a header bar, and the mark leading a sign-in Card.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "flex flex-col gap-8") do
    header(class: "border-border flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl border px-4 py-3") do
      Logo(size: :sm, href: "#home", aria_label: "Behumble.com home")
      nav(class: "flex items-center gap-2") do
        Button(variant: :ghost, size: :sm) { "Pricing" }
        Button(size: :sm) { "Sign up" }
      end
    end

    Card(frame: :solid, as: :form, action: "#", class: "mx-auto w-full max-w-90") do
      CardHeader do
        Logo(variant: :mark, size: :md)
        CardTitle(class: "mt-2 text-xl") { "Sign in to Behumble" }
        CardDescription { "Grow a little every day - pick up where you left off." }
      end
      CardFooter { Button(type: "submit", class: "w-full") { "Continue" } }
    end
  end
end

examples.name: Dark background
examples.notes:
The ring follows the foreground colour and the ring fill follows the background,
so the mark works in both themes.
examples.code:
phlex do
  div(class: "dark bg-background flex justify-center rounded-xl p-8") do
    Logo(size: :lg)
  end
end
